intro: Grunt Dogran is an orc soldier of the Horde held prisoner deep within the quilboar territory of the southern Barrens. Originally assigned to the Crossroads and later Camp Taurajo, his patrol met with disaster during a raid on Agama'gor.

p: Following his promotion within the Horde military, Grunt Dogran was dispatched from the Crossroads to reinforce Camp Taurajo. While leading a detachment of grunts into the bristled territory of Agama'gor, his unit clashed fiercely with the Bristleback quilboar. Severely injured and crippled during the fray, Dogran could not be carried away by his retreating comrades and was dragged into captivity.
